text:
Type: compact one-door storage cabinet
Use: storing media, books and everyday items behind a door; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white matte laminated board, smooth flat door, small plastic feet
Colors: pure white
Shape: simple boxy cube with one full flush handleless door, crisp square edges, low feet, clean and compact, light visual weight
Feel: clean, quiet, tidy, neutral
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey textiles, black accents; Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms and home offices

product.name: BEST
product.description: May be completed with knobs or handles. Sold separately. View more product information A simple unit can be enough storage for a limited space or the foundation for a larger storage solution if your needs change.
